headword: {旅客列車|りょかくれっしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A train that carries passengers, as opposed to one that carries freight. The standard technical term used by railway operators, contrasted with {貨物列車|かもつれっしゃ} (freight train).

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{旅客列車|りょかくれっしゃ}です。
examples.english: The next train to arrive is a passenger train.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{路線|ろせん}→路線：11341_rosen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{旅客列車|りょかくれっしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{貨物列車|かもつれっしゃ}→貨物列車：16297_kamotsuressha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{共用|きょうよう}→共用：21529_kyouyou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Passenger and freight trains share this line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昭和|しょうわ}→昭和：28079_shouwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{長距離|ちょうきょり}→長距離：09271_choukyori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{旅客列車|りょかくれっしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{食堂車|しょくどうしゃ}→食堂車：23784_shokudousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{連結|れんけつ}→連結：14388_renketsu⟧⟦されていた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: During the Showa era, long-distance passenger trains had dining cars attached.

notes:
A technical railway term combining ⟦{旅客|りょかく}→旅客：12950_ryokaku⟧ (passenger) and ⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧ (train). Found in timetables, railway announcements, and news about rail accidents. In everyday speech people usually just say ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旅客列車|りょかくれっしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通過|つうか}する→通過する：22435_tsuukasuru⟧: a passenger train passes through
- {旅客列車|りょかくれっしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運行|うんこう}→運行：14375_unkou⟧: operation of passenger trains
- ⟦{長距離|ちょうきょり}→長距離：09271_choukyori⟧{旅客列車|りょかくれっしゃ}: long-distance passenger train

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧: train — the everyday word; preferred in conversation
- ⟦{貨物列車|かもつれっしゃ}→貨物列車：16297_kamotsuressha⟧: freight train — the counterpart that carries cargo instead of passengers
- ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}{列車|れっしゃ}→特急列車：25987_tokkyuuressha⟧: limited express train — a type of passenger train that stops only at major stations
